summaries.name: web-pane-comes-back-after-hide

results.label: a web pane opened
its view is in the shell window to begin with
hiding the window takes the page off screen
coming back puts the page on screen again, with no user action (#75)
it comes back in the box it left
switching workspace still parks the page
a page parked on purpose is NOT put back by a hide and a return

notes: [shell] web host restoring 1 parked view(s) (window-shown): 1 placed, 0 still parked

summaries.name: web-pane-crashed-card

results.label: `kelpi web open` opened a web pane
the fixture is running before anything is crashed
no card on a healthy pane
a single renderer death rebuilds itself, with no card
results.detail: the page answers a read again

results.label: and still no card afterwards
a repeat crash raises the stopped-responding card
it says what happened
it names the address
the nav row and the page hole are still there around it
`kelpi web tabs` reports the tab as not live
the card carries a Reload button
clicking Reload brings the page back
results.detail: the page answers a read after Reload

results.label: and the card takes itself down
